name: sampler2
title: Flexure sampler 2: a compound guide, a constant-force mechanism and a LET joint, on one rail
orientation: Flat on the bed as drawn. The guide and the constant-force leaf bend in the plane of the bed; the LET joint folds its outer panel up out of the bed, which is the one place the layers are bent across (print it in PETG too). 100% infill, 0.2 mm layers. The crank is held to the rail by a two-line tab: snap it off and pin it to the coupler's boss and the ground boss with two 12 mm bits of filament.

height.rule: The guide's and the mechanism's width, up from the bed: 40 layers

rail.rule: The rail the parts stand off, along y

spacing.rule: From one part to the next along the rail

gap.rule: The compound guide's inner leaves apart

clearance.rule: Room between the guide's inner and outer leaves, and its shuttle and base: the travel it can make

guide_width.rule: The compound guide across, along x: inner leaves, outer leaves, clearances and the base's arms

base_depth.rule: The guide's shuttle face to its back bar's inner face: stood on the rail so the back bar sits in it

cfm_thickness.rule: The coupler leaf: three lines, 1.7 N

crank.rule: The crank, pin to pin: half the leaf for the flattest force

pin_fit.rule: Room round a pin in the ground boss

boss.rule: A boss's radius round a pin

slider.rule: The coupler's slider block, along the leaf: sits in the rail

post.rule: The post carrying the ground boss off the rail

loose.rule: The loose crank's gap from the rail

let_width.rule: The LET joint's hinge, along its axis

let_thickness.rule: The LET joint's sheet: six layers

bar.rule: A torsion bar's width: five lines

panel.rule: The LET joint's panels either side of the hinge

slider_block.rule: The guide's shuttle and base blocks, along the leaves

reach.rule: The crank's reach along the slider's line at its 5° rest angle: cos 5°

offset.rule: The ground pin beside the slider's line at rest: sin 5°, so the leaf prints straight

let_half.rule: Half the LET joint across its hinge: a panel, a slot and a half, a bar

overlap.rule: How far a part sits into the rail, so they join

tab.rule: The tab holding the loose crank to the rail: two lines, to snap off
